about_background_intro: Hey! I'm Jean, a {#em}Software Developer{/em} and Computer Science student based in Colombia.
about_background_childhood: I've always been interested in technology; as a kid I would tinker with every device I could get my hands on at home. Most did not survive. One time I put an {#link href=|https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arepa|}arepa{/link} inside a DVD; I'm not exactly sure what happened to it afterwards, but my parents weren't happy.
about_background_first_steps: My first contact with programming was at secondary school, in the "Informatics" class, through {#link href=|https://scratch.mit.edu|}Scratch{/link}, alongside some basic HTML and CSS later on. This basic understanding of what was possible with computers, coupled with my love for videogames, led me to enroll in a Multimedia Engineering degree right after graduation, and later on switch to Systems Engineering (the equivalent of Computer Science in Colombia).
about_background_projects_link: From then on, I've focused on building software that solves real problems for myself and others, while exploring Computer Science on my own. Feel free to take a look at {#link href=|/projects|}some of the things I've built{/link}, you might find something that makes your life easier!
contact_intro: I'm always interested in meeting other {#em}developers{/em} and {#em}people{/em}, discovering {#em}interesting projects{/em}, and exploring {#em}new ideas.{/em}
contact_find_me: If you'd like to {#em}get in touch{/em} or see what I'm working on, you can {#em}find me{/em} here.
education_multimedia_motivation: I got into this degree out of love for {#em}videogames{/em} and {#em}video editing{/em}, and in it my love for {#em}coding{/em} was born.
education_multimedia_dropout: Due to financial constraints, I had no option but to drop out (it's a private university), but I managed to finish the first half of the degree before moving onto {#em}Universidad del Valle{/em} to study {#em}Computer Science{/em}.
education_systems_degree: Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering (Computer Science)
hobby_programming_description: I'm particularly interested in low level concepts and theory, and building cool things across many domains such as {#em}games{/em}, {#em}websites{/em}, {#em}CLI{/em} tools and more!
hobby_reading_description: I enjoy reading both {#em}fiction{/em} and {#em}non-fiction{/em}, across a vast array of genres; for fiction I love {#em}classic literature{/em} and {#em}Hard Sci-Fi{/em}. At the moment my favourite book series is {#em}The Three Body Problem{/em}!
hobby_games_description: I love {#em}chess{/em}, cozy indie games and AAA games like {#em}Halo{/em}, {#em}Titanfall{/em} and {#em}Battlefield{/em}.
